advisories.reason: No patched braces release exists (<=3.0.3 affected; 3.0.3 is latest). Reached only through tailwindcss 3 at build time (chokidar, micromatch, fast-glob); never shipped in the bundle, and the glob patterns come from tailwind.config.js, not users. Lasting fix is the Tailwind 4 migration.

monaco-editor 0.57.0 (latest) runs its own vendored DOMPurify 3.4.15, so an npm override would only silence the audit, not change the shipped code. Exploitation requires sanitize(node, { IN_PLACE: true }); Monaco's domSanitize.js only sanitizes strings (RETURN_DOM_FRAGMENT / RETURN_TRUSTED_TYPE) and the app never imports DOMPurify. Remove when Monaco ships DOMPurify >= 3.4.16.
Same vendored DOMPurify 3.4.15 in monaco-editor 0.57.0; this advisory also requires IN_PLACE mode on a Node input, which Monaco never uses. Remove when Monaco ships DOMPurify >= 3.4.16.
